name: ai-tutor
title_zh: 翻开哪页就教哪页的私人 vault 陪读
tagline_zh: 在你自己攒的 Markdown 笔记库里学概念、读论文，它先摸清你写过什么，再出题考你。
tagline_en: Learn concepts or papers inside your personal notes. It reads what you've written, quizzes you on gaps, and.
desc_en: State-aware tutor for this personal Markdown learning and research vault; use when learning a concept, reading a paper, testing understanding, reviewing, or diagnosing weaknesses.
why_zh: 别的 tutor 拿通用知识教，它拿你亲手写的笔记教——诊断依据是你 vault 里的原文。
why_en: Unlike generic tutors, it teaches from your own writing—diagnosing against your vault's content and routing review back to your.
limit_zh: 只认本机 Markdown vault 结构，不读 PDF/网页/数据库；没建好个人笔记库的人装上无米下锅。
limit_en: Requires a local Markdown vault; ignores PDFs/web/DBs. Useless without an established note base. Teaches only—does not organize or clean your notes.
title_en: A state-aware tutor that teaches from your own Markdown.
